description: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. It explains Roy's portfolio and offerings, shows case studies in inline ChatGPT cards, captures your goal, answers with Roy's curated concierge guidance, and escalates finance, legal, pricing, contracts, and low-confidence matters to Roy personally. Skills cover intake, discovery, showcase, advisory answers, meeting proposals, recall, and human handoff. Identity is verified by email and engagement records stay in Roy's workspace.
